Description:
Added the unique Role "Mage".
Mages are not content with specializing in a single function but aspire to become more powerful "all-around characters." Typically, a Mage-type character possesses the abilities to deal damage, heal teammates, and protect allies simultaneously.
The base skills of a Mage-type character are replaced with 6x basic spells. These spells can target allies for healing and shields or target enemies for damage.
The Mage-type Class gains the attributes of all professions in the Kaleidoscope.
Additionally, brand-new "Mage's Potion" and "Skillbook - Mage Patterns" have been introduced for Mage-type characters.

Usage Instructions:
Please place this mod below the "BasicMethods" mod and above other Mage Role character mods, then enable it.

For Modders:
If you need to use the Mage Role, after adding this mod as a dependency, change the "Role" entry in the character's .json file to "RoleMage".
